title: Fem Concepts
description: FEA input concepts for viewer visualization: masses, boundary conditions, constraints, and load scenarios. Purely geometric (positions, vectors, scalars, labels) — the viewer draws glyphs from these, it carries no FEA solver semantics.

masses.description: Point masses (e.g. lumped equipment mass at deck feet).

bcs.description: Boundary conditions: a set of restrained node positions and which dofs are fixed.

constraints.description: Constraints (coupling, tie, rigid body, mpc, shell-to-solid): the master and slave node positions each one ties together.

scenarios.description: Load scenarios (one per load case AND per load combination), each pre-resolved to a flat list of load glyphs so the viewer can cycle through them and render scenario[i].loads directly.

equipment.description: Equipment placed in the model: one box per distinct placement, with its mass and the load cases that place it there.

Vec3.description: An [x, y, z] triple in model units.

dofs.description: Restrained degrees of freedom, 1..6 (1-3 translation, 4-6 rotation).

constraint_type.description: Constraint type (coupling, tie, rigid body, mpc, shell2solid).

dofs.description: Constrained degrees of freedom, 1..6 (1-3 translation, 4-6 rotation).

influence_distance.description: Influence distance, where the source defined one.

position_tolerance.description: Position tolerance, where the source defined one.

position.description: Point load location / line start / acceleration anchor.

magnitude.description: Force magnitude / pressure / acceleration magnitude (drives arrow color/label). For a line load, the intensity at its start.

end_magnitude.description: Line load intensity at its end, along the same direction, where it differs from the start.

generated_by.description: The equipment this load was resolved from, when the analysis model generated it rather than a user applying it.

origin.description: Origin of the equipment's placed frame.

axes.description: The placed frame's x, y and z directions, unit vectors in model coordinates.

box_min.description: Lower corner of the equipment box, in the placed frame.

box_max.description: Upper corner of the equipment box, in the placed frame.

cog.description: Centre of gravity in model coordinates.

load_cases.description: The load cases that place the equipment here.

kind.description: Whether this scenario is a single load case or a (factored) combination.

loads.description: Resolved load glyphs for this scenario.
